Ailment:
Severe status effects include: Frozen, Stun, Immobilize, and Frenzy.
After a target is inflicted with an Ailment, the chance of ailment infliction next turn is halved and keeps dropping with each consecutive infliction.
Airborne:
Targets in the airborne cannot counterattack with attack animations. Blocking removes the airborne state. Large targets cannot be knocked airborne.
Airborne is a brief state. If left unharmed, the airborne target will soon fall and return to normal.
Approach:
After being knocked back, if Movement is above 0, approaches the target to unleash a Technique.
Before the caster's turn ends, if a Technique is ready but out of range, spends remaining Movement to approach the nearest target.
Armor Break 2:
Reduces DEF by 30%.
When multiple levels of the same status exist, only the highest level takes effect.
Base Chance: Represents the base chance of inflicting ailments on the target. The final chance is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit and the target's Effect RES.
Battle Zeal: Increases Technique DMG taken from the inflicter and makes you their priority target. The mark is removed after taking Technique DMG 4 times.
Before Battle Starts:
When multiple units on both sides are set to cast skills before battle starts, they cast them from highest to lowest initial SPD. SPD changes during this phase do not affect the order.
If a character has multiple skills to cast before battle starts, Charms are cast before Techniques. Skills of the same type are cast in loadout order, from top to bottom.
Battle starts after all such skills from both sides have been cast.
Blade Soul: Each stack increases the caster's DMG dealt. Casting a Technique that damages an enemy removes 1 stack.
Blast Spirit:
Activates the Blast Spirit at the end of the caster's turn. If an enemy is within 2 grids of the caster, it explodes to deal Fire DMG once to all enemies within range.
Explosion DMG counts as Technique DMG.
Blessing: A character can only receive one Blessing at a time.
Blind: The next damaging Technique has a 50% chance to miss.
Blood Source: When a target with Blood Source takes Technique DMG, 3% of the DMG dealt is converted to the attacker's HP (up to 50% of max HP). DMG taken by shields does not trigger this effect.
Burn:
Inflicts Burn for 3 turns, dealing Fire DMG once to enemies with it.
DMG Triggers:
1. When the grids is newly inflicted with Burn;
2. When an enemy moves to the Burned grids (doesn't apply to traversal);
3. At the start of a turn for an enemy standing on the Burned grids.
Multiple instances of Burn DMG from the same skill by the same caster in one turn are reduced by 35% successively, up to 3 times.
Notes:
1. On the same grid, the newly inflicted Burn will replace the old one.
2. Burn cannot be inflicted on water surfaces.
Charge: Removes stacks when certain skills are used to boost their effects, stacking up to 20 times. Cannot be dispelled.
Clone:
The clone's type (Character, Summon, Monster, Fantomon, etc.) matches the connected target.
When the clone takes lethal DMG, that DMG (including any overflow) chains to the connected target.
When the clone disappears, any debuffs on it chain to the connected target.
Cold: Increases Water DMG taken by 5%. Stacks up to 10 times.
Cripple: Each stack reduces Movement by 25% and SPD by 10%, stacking up to 3 times.
Debuff: Negative effects include: stat reduction (e.g., ATK Reduction), DMG over time (e.g., Erosion), increased DMG taken (e.g., Shattering Sigil), Blind, Taunt, etc.
Dodge: When attacked, the bearer has a 50% chance to be immune to the incoming DMG.
Doom DMG:
Shield Break: Deals +100% DMG to the enemy target's shields.
Deals +100% DMG to enemy summons.
Electro: When the target with Electro takes Light DMG from a Technique, removes the Electro to deal additional Light DMG once and chains it to 1 random enemy within 2 grids of the target grid where DMG is dealt.
Enhanced Effect: After Blast Spirit activates, it moves to the best detonation spot within 3 grids of the caster, then explodes.
Erosion: At the start of each turn, triggers Erosion once, dealing Dark DMG once. Erosion lasts for 3 turns. If the same character inflicts Erosion again with the same skill, the duration stacks.
Fear: Will not prioritize the inflictor of this status as an attack target.
Flame: Deals Fire DMG once to all enemies in a 1-grid square area of the bearer. Triggers: when the status is gained, at the start of the bearer's turn, after the bearer moves, and when enemy targets enter the range. DMG is attributed to the caster. This effect does not stack.
Frozen: Prevents movement and skill use during the affected unit's turn. Also blocks activation of Charms or states that require casting. Lasts 2 turns.
Heal: When casting healing Techniques, only heals targets with less than 100% HP. Healing power is based on the caster's max HP.
Lifesteal: Heals the caster for a percentage of DMG dealt to the target. DMG to shields does not trigger this effect.
Movement: Usually, characters can move up to 4 grids per turn. Movement from skills is separate and does not count towards this limit.
Potion: A potion brewed with the Charm: Rejuvenating Elixir.
Ravenous Mark: Increases DMG taken from the inflicter and their affiliated units (Summons/Fantomons) by 15%.
Razor: Each stack increases the caster's DMG dealt by 1% until the end of turn, stacking up to 20 times.
Rhythm: Upon taking lethal DMG, the caster survives with 1 HP, consumes 1 stack of Rhythm, and heals the caster once.
Riven Heart: Reduces Block Rate by 10%. Stacks up to 3 times.
Rune:
Water Rune: Increases the caster's Elemental Mastery.
Fire Rune: Increases the caster's Crit DMG.
Wind Rune: Increases the caster's Effect Hit Rate.
Light Rune: Increases the caster's Accuracy.
Shatter: Each stack increases DMG taken. If inflicted by multiple casters, only the first stack takes effect.
Shield:
Absorbs DMG, depleted before HP when taking DMG.
When multiple shields are present:
1. Shields with a turn limit are depleted first, followed by shields without a turn limit;
2. Shields of the same type are depleted in order they applied.
Slow 1:
Reduces SPD by 15%.
When multiple levels of the same status exist, only the highest level takes effect.
Slow 2:
Reduces SPD by 30%.
When multiple levels of the same status exist, only the highest level takes effect.
Solidarity: Increases DEF. For each allied character within 2 grids of the caster, this effect is increased by 40%, up to 120%. Cannot be dispelled.
Spirit Mark: When the bearer takes single DMG exceeding 4% of max HP, consumes the Marks to reduce DMG taken.
Summon:
Summon's level equals the skill level.
Summons cannot receive any stat boosts.
Taunt: Taunted enemies target the caster only, and approach the caster when using damaging Techniques. Summoning Techniques remain available, but ally-targeting Techniques (grant buffs, healing, shields, etc.) are disabled while taunted.
True DMG: Fixed DMG, unaffected by Effects and Affinities.
Unique: When a target is affected by this effect multiple times, only the best effect is retained.
Vigil: A character can only receive Vigil once at a time, and Vigil cannot protect the caster themselves.
Vulnerability: Increases DMG taken by 25%. Lasts 1 turn.
Weakened 1:
Reduces ATK by 15%.
When multiple levels of the same status exist, only the highest level takes effect.
Weakened 2:
Reduces ATK by 30%.
When multiple levels of the same status exist, only the highest level takes effect.
Wet: Increases the chance of being Frozen by 30%.
Wind Orb:
At the end of the caster's turn, the caster selects a target within 4 grids of the caster. Each Wind Orb then attacks that target, dealing Wind DMG once per orb.
Max Wind Orbs (All Sources): 10
Zero Initial CD: This skill can be cast on the caster's first turn and enters cooldown after casting.
